title: carex praecox subsp. polyrrhiza
intro: Carex praecox subsp. polyrrhiza, commonly known as green sedge, is a perennial plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae) characterized by its dense, green, and triangular leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to support various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of green sedge include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Carex praecox subsp. polyrrhiza include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
